testcase.name: Scenario: Choose panel titles as the ribbon minimization mode: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:157:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Choose panel titles as the ribbon minimization mode ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon is expanded ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display control menu ✔ And the user chooses Minimize to Panel Titles ✔ Then the Tools command groups are reduced to a narrow strip of titles ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control ✔ Then the full Tools command groups are visible ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control again ✔ Then the Tools ribbon displays the group-title strip ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display control menu ✔ Then Minimize to Panel Titles is checked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the display menu closes and the group-title strip remains ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control ✔ Then the full Tools command groups are visible
